scripts.bootstrap: cargo fetch --manifest-path=rust/Cargo.toml && cargo install cargo-watch --locked && bun install --cwd=ui --frozen-lockfile && bun install --cwd=site --frozen-lockfile
scripts.dev:api: cargo watch -C rust -w crates -w Cargo.toml -w Cargo.lock -x "run -p sempre-client -- daemon --development-root ../.cache/sempre-dev/runtime --listen 127.0.0.1:33212"
scripts.lint: bun --cwd=ui run lint && bun --cwd=site run lint && shellcheck installer/install.sh installer/install_test.sh rust/scripts/server_smoke.sh
scripts.tsc: bun --cwd=ui run tsc && bun --cwd=site run tsc
scripts.test: bun --cwd=ui run test && bun --cwd=site run test && sh installer/install_test.sh
